description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Read a fixed list of public HTML pages in one call—the same article extraction as POST /v1/text for each URL (Markdown or plain text plus title and metadata). One x402 payment covers the batch (minimum 3 pages quoted; URLs deduped, max 50). Returns results in input order: each item has url, status_code, text, billed, and hint when undelivered, plus batch-level delivered, failed, billed_pages, and optional credit for unused pages. Undelivered pages are not billed. Use readfetch_text for one URL, readfetch_map then readfetch_crawl to discover and walk a site, readfetch_scrape when JavaScript is required. Read-only; 402 without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE like other paid tools.

accept_language.description: Accept-Language header for every item, e.g. 'de-DE,de;q=0.9'. Defaults to en-US when omitted.

format.description: Per-item output flavour, same as /v1/text: markdown (default) or plain text.

pipeline.description: text (default) = HTTP-first per URL, same as readfetch_text; use render when probe reported challenge:true or items need JavaScript — bills like scrape per undelivered page, not like plain text.

timeout_s.description: Total budget for the whole batch in seconds; every item shares it and no item restarts it.

urls.description: URLs to read, deduped before quoting.

name: readfetch_batch
